hypothesis: The deployable pitch-type MoE is bottlenecked by temporal class-prior drift in its selector. The row's official as-of pitcher pitch-mix is a legal row-local prior; pooling it with the context CatBoost probabilities can improve marginalization without current-pitch TrackMan.
selection_labels: historical official pitch_type_group only; control_success is not read during selector selection

selector_inputs.context_probability: the same e22_cat CatBoost trained on matched seasons strictly before each query season

selection_rule: minimize the worst multiclass log loss across 2020 and 2021; break ties by mean log loss, then lexical candidate id
